description: Add or drop the per-project PostgreSQL database. Action 'enable' adds a database to an existing app (idempotent; no data is touched), and the app receives DATABASE_URL from its next deploy. Dropping a database is deliberately a separate operation from deleting an app, and credentials are never returned. To remove an app and its data, drop the database before the app is deleted: an app-only deletion leaves its database retained, and once the app is deleted this tool can no longer reach it (removal then needs separately authorized operator cleanup). For action 'drop' — DESTRUCTIVE: this cannot be undone. Use it only when the user has explicitly asked, in this conversation, to delete this specific project; never on your own to free a project slot, fix an error or clean up. It works in two calls. The first call (without confirm) deletes nothing: it returns what would be deleted and a confirmationCode. Show that to the user and ask them to confirm. Only after they say yes, call again with confirm set to the exact project slug and the confirmationCode (valid 10 minutes, one use).

action.description: 'enable' adds a database to the app ('provision' is an older name for it); 'drop' deletes the data (two calls, see description).

confirm.description: Second 'drop' call only: the exact project slug, after the user explicitly agreed.

confirmationCode.description: Second 'drop' call only: the confirmationCode from the first call.

name: configure_database
